messages.content: The resort transfer form looks incomplete. It only shows my flight, and the pickup cutoff says 12:30 p.m. even though we land at 1:02. Please make sure the included ride will actually be there for both of us.

I’ll verify whether 12:30 p.m. is an arrival cutoff or a form-processing deadline, then add the second traveler and reconcile the transfer record with airline confirmation K7M4QX. What is your spouse’s full legal name as shown on the ticket?
Anil Raj Nair. We are on the same reservation and both flights are unchanged.

I found both passengers on the booking. The outbound is flight AS 1342 from SFO on November 28 at 8:10 a.m., arriving PVR at 1:02 p.m. The return is AS 1339 on December 4 at 2:20 p.m., arriving SFO at 4:38 p.m. I’ve sent the complete record to the resort and asked them to clarify the cutoff before finalizing the transfer.
Please also get the exact meeting point and what we should do if immigration or baggage takes longer than expected.

The resort confirmed that 12:30 p.m. is the same-day request-processing cutoff, not the latest eligible flight arrival. Your scheduled 1:02 p.m. arrival qualifies for the included private pickup. They have now listed Priya Nair and Anil Raj Nair together, but I’m waiting for the dispatch contact and precise meeting instructions.
Good. I want the contact details in the itinerary, not just a note that the transfer is included.
Understood. I’m adding the operating instructions and checking that the transfer confirmation references both the flight record and resort booking PV8R26.

The round-trip private transfer is finalized for both travelers under transfer confirmation TR-PV8R26. After customs at PVR, exit into the ground-transportation hall and go to Booth 6; the driver will hold a placard reading “PV8R26 / Nair.” If delayed, call or send WhatsApp to +52 322 226 8410 before leaving the terminal. Dispatch will monitor AS 1342 and wait up to 90 minutes after the actual landing time. The record now includes both passengers, outbound AS 1342 arriving November 28 at 1:02 p.m., return AS 1339 departing December 4 at 2:20 p.m., and resort confirmation PV8R26. Return pickup time will be delivered to the room by 6:00 p.m. on December 3.
